# [Feat] [NPU] linear-attention: Enable ReplaySSM ring decode via triton-ascend

## Motivation

`--enable-linear-replayssm` (ReplaySSM ring decode) previously worked on CUDA only: at decode time, a shared Triton ring kernel (`fused_recurrent_linear_replayssm`) replays the last `--linear-replayssm-cache-len` steps of per-token inputs to reconstruct / roll back SSM states, supporting state restore and radix-track-boundary force flush. The NPU (Ascend) GDN/KDA hybrid linear-attention backends were not wired up, so hybrid linear-attention models (Qwen3.5, Kimi-Linear, ...) could not use the feature on NPU. This PR routes the NPU decode path through the same ring kernel (compiled via triton-ascend) and fixes a pad-row state-corruption bug exposed while bringing it up.

## Modifications

**Feature enablement**
- `ascend_hybrid_linear_attn_backend.py`: add `ReplaySSMDecodeMixin` — detects when the ring is live (pool flag, cursor presence, KDA bounded-gate fallback) and hands the post-conv packed qkv straight to the ring kernel; `AscendMambaAttnBackendBase` allocates static per-bs `replayssm_write_pos_list` / `replayssm_force_flush_list`, captured by pointer and refreshed in place before each graph replay.
- `ascend_gdn_backend.py` / `ascend_kda_backend.py`: wire the decode paths through the mixin (falls back byte-identically to the legacy per-step decode whenever the ring is not usable).
- `hybrid_linear_attn_backend.py`: extract the ring-cursor snapshot+advance logic from the CUDA `_replay_metadata` inline block into `_replayssm_graph_buffers`, so CUDA and Ascend share one implementation (radix-track flush, L-1 wrap, slot dedup).

**Correctness fixes**
- Pad-row sentinel: under graph replay, padding rows' `mamba_cache_indices` changed from `0` to `pad_slot_id` (-1) — previously they read/wrote physical slot 0's conv/ring state (root cause of repetition/garbled text and the GSM8K baseline collapse).
- NPU conv decode: `cache_indices.clamp_min(0)`, since the CANN conv op has no verified skip semantics for -1.
- Kernel workarounds for triton-ascend 3.2's rejection of 3-operand boolean chains (`fused_recurrent_linear_replayssm.py`, `fused_sigmoid_gating_recurrent.py`).

**Argument validation**
- `attention_hook.py`: with the flag on for NPU, require `--linear-attn-decode-backend triton` (the ring kernel runs through triton-ascend); error out when `mamba-radix-cache-strategy` is not `no_buffer`, with a page-size hint.

Debug-only instrumentation (KDA prefill in-situ probe, shadow-cursor validator) is intentionally not included; equivalent debugging capability lives in the kernel-level UT `debug/test_npu_linear_replayssm_decode.py`.

## Accuracy Tests

| Test | Model (path) | Result |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8K | Qwen3.5-9B (GDN, L=16, TP2, concurrent bs>1) | ring 0.885 vs baseline 0.905 (std≈0.3, within noise); ring confirmed engaged |
| E2E greedy parity | Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct (KDA, L=4, TP2, CUDA graph on) | identical trajectory prefix ≥ 2L; per-token logprob dev mean≤0.05 / max≤0.25 (bf16-drift bound); repeated request deterministic |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

GSM8K A/B (Qwen3.5-9B, TP2, identical config except the flag):

| | Baseline | Ring (L=16) |
|---|---|---|
| Output throughput | 434.6 tok/s | 360.3 tok/s (-17%) |
| Eval latency | 51.3 s | 61.1 s |

The overhead is by design: each decode step replays the last L ring records per layer (memory-read amplification and compute scale linearly with L), plus ~3.4 GB of ring buffers per rank. The cost shrinks with a smaller `--linear-replayssm-cache-len`.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests) (kernel-level UT in `debug/test_npu_linear_replayssm_decode.py`; e2e in `debug/test_npu_linear_replayssm_e2e.py` — both are debug-directory tests, move into CI registration as needed).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+# One-shot logs, keyed by reason: these paths run per layer per forward.

+def _log_once(key: str, msg: str, *, warning: bool = False) -> None:
+    if key not in _logged_once:
+        _logged_once.add(key)
+        (logger.warning if warning else logger.info)(msg)
+

+class ReplaySSMDecodeMixin:
+    """ReplaySSM decode ring (--enable-linear-replayssm) for an Ascend backend.
+
+    The ring kernel is the gate-generic Triton implementation shared with CUDA
+    (``sglang.kernels...fla.fused_recurrent_linear_replayssm``); it runs on
+    Ascend through triton-ascend, so this only has to detect that the ring is
+    live for the pool + layer and hand the *packed* post-conv qkv to that kernel
+    instead of splitting q/k/v for the per-step decode. Cursor advance and
+    force-flush stay in the shared metadata path.
+    """

+        """Ring tensors + cursor for this layer, or None to keep the legacy path."""
+        mamba_pool = getattr(self.req_to_token_pool, "mamba_pool", None)
+        if mamba_pool is None or not getattr(

+            return None
+        if getattr(mamba_pool, "replayssm_spec_fold", False):
+            return None
+        write_pos = getattr(self.forward_metadata, "replayssm_write_pos", None)
+        if write_pos is None:
+            _log_once(
+                "no_cursor",
+                "--enable-linear-replayssm on NPU: no ring cursor in this forward "
+                "metadata; falling back to the per-step decode.",
+                warning=True,
+            )
+            return None
+        if is_kda and getattr(layer, "lower_bound", None) is not None:
+            # Bounded (safe) gate: the ring kernel implements the plain softplus
+            # gate only, so this layer keeps the per-step decode (as on CUDA).
+            _log_once(
+                "kda_lower_bound",
+                "--enable-linear-replayssm on NPU: this KDA layer uses a bounded "
+                "gate, which the ring kernel does not implement; decoding per-step.",
+                warning=True,
+            )
+            return None
+        d_cache = layer_cache.replayssm_d
+        k_cache = layer_cache.replayssm_k
+        g_cache = layer_cache.replayssm_g
+        if d_cache is None or k_cache is None or g_cache is None:
+            return None

+            d_cache,
+            k_cache,
+            g_cache,
+            write_pos,

+        if args is None:
+            return None
+        d_cache, k_cache, g_cache, write_pos, force_flush = args
+        # Geometry the kernel infers from the state pool [slots, HV, V, K].
+        hv, v_dim, k_dim = ssm_states.shape[1:]
+        if is_kda:
+            # Per-K gate: a arrives [B, HV*K], dt_bias [HV*K], A_log [1, 1, HV, 1].
+            B = packed_qkv.shape[0]
+            a = a.reshape(B, hv, k_dim).contiguous()
+            dt_bias = layer.dt_bias.reshape(hv, k_dim).contiguous()
+            A_log = layer.A_log.reshape(-1)
+            b = b.reshape(B, hv).contiguous()
+        else:
+            dt_bias, A_log = layer.dt_bias, layer.A_log
+        _log_once(

+            is_kda=is_kda,
